# Olson Pro Wash (Olson Landscaping Pro Wash LLC)

> Locally owned pressure washing, roof cleaning and landscaping company based in
> Lake Stevens, Washington, serving Snohomish County and North King County.
> Founded by Ethan Olson. Licensed, bonded and insured. Phone: (425) 446-0547.
> Rated 4.9/5 on Google (54+ reviews). Hours: Mon–Fri 7am–6pm, Sat 8am–2pm.

Key facts:
- Business name: Olson Pro Wash / Olson Landscaping Pro Wash LLC
- Owner/founder: Ethan Olson (Lake Stevens, WA)
- Base city: Lake Stevens, WA 98258
- Service area: Lake Stevens, Everett, Marysville, Arlington, Snohomish, Monroe,
  Mill Creek, Mukilteo, Bothell, Kirkland, Sammamish, Issaquah — Snohomish & King County
- Methods: soft washing (low pressure + detergent) for roofs and siding;
  hot-water pressure washing for concrete, brick and pavers
- Free, itemized, same-day quotes. Satisfaction guarantee.

## Services

- [Roof Cleaning](https://olsonprowash.com/services#roof-cleaning): Low-pressure roof soft wash that removes moss, lichen and black streaks at the root, plus a zinc/copper treatment to slow regrowth. No high pressure, no granule loss, no voided warranty. From $499.
- [House Washing](https://olsonprowash.com/services#house-washing): Whole-home exterior soft wash of siding, soffits, trim and gutter faces. From $299.
- [Pressure Washing](https://olsonprowash.com/services#pressure-washing): Hot-water pressure washing for concrete, brick, pavers and stone. From $199.
- [Soft Washing](https://olsonprowash.com/services#soft-washing): Low-pressure detergent cleaning for stucco, cedar, painted surfaces and fences. From $249.
- [Gutter Cleaning](https://olsonprowash.com/services#gutter-cleaning): Hand clear-out, downspout flush and exterior face wash. From $149.
- [Gutter Guard Installation](https://olsonprowash.com/services/gutter-guard-installation): Stainless micro-mesh gutter guards fitted to the roofline. From $8/linear ft.
- [Deck & Patio Cleaning](https://olsonprowash.com/services#deck-patio-cleaning): Wood, composite and stone, cleaned at the right pressure for the material. From $229.
- [Driveway & Concrete Cleaning](https://olsonprowash.com/services#driveway-concrete-cleaning): Streak-free rotary surface cleaning with stain treatment. From $189.
- [Commercial Services](https://olsonprowash.com/services#commercial-services): Recurring or one-time exterior maintenance for retail, restaurants, HOAs and property managers. Quoted per site.
- [Landscaping](https://olsonprowash.com/services#landscaping): Bed design, mulch, edging, shrub trimming and seasonal clean-ups. From $179.

- [Issaquah, WA](https://olsonprowash.com/service-area/issaquah-wa): Foothill homes, steep roofs, shaded damp hardscapes; roof cleaning and deck restoration.

## Common questions

- Roofs are always soft washed (low pressure), never pressure washed — high pressure strips granules and voids most shingle warranties.
- Typical roof soft wash in the Lake Stevens area runs $499–$1,000 depending on slope area and moss coverage.
- Most Pacific Northwest homes should be washed once a year; roofs every 1–2 years.
- Detergents are biodegradable, applied at safe dilution, with landscaping pre-wet and rinsed.
- Olson Pro Wash is licensed, bonded and insured in Washington and provides a certificate of insurance on request.
